view.label: view
view.desc: Reading lists, details, PDFs and exports within the function (HTTP GET). Without it the function is practically unusable.

create.label: create
create.desc: Starting a new record or action: new task, partner, settlement, ticket, receipt, signature, sending (HTTP POST).

edit.label: edit
edit.desc: Changing an existing record: data, status, prices, settings (HTTP PUT/PATCH).

delete.label: delete
delete.desc: Deleting or revoking a record within the function (HTTP DELETE). Permanent deletions also need the separate “Delete functions” right.

desc.dashboard: Dashboard: the company's daily status on one screen — due settlements, open tickets and tasks, low stock, receivables, revenue. Read-only; it does not grant access to the underlying lists.
desc.tasks: Task management (manager side): issue worksheets/tasks to any employee, assign, due dates and rescheduling (with reason), price editor (our prices), worksheet print/e-mail, quote flow, closing. Also gives the Technician handover page. Employees get their OWN tasks via “My tasks”, not this.
desc.schedule: Schedule: plan and assign shifts for all employees, skill-based suggestions. Employees see their own via “My schedule”.
desc.attendance: Attendance (manager): daily presence, clock in/out records, absentees, direct absence entry. Not needed for self-service clock in/out.
desc.timeoff: Time off (manager): approve/reject leave requests, yearly quota, substitutes.
desc.employees: Employees: view and edit the employee master (name, contact, login, role, skills). Revealing sensitive data (social security, bank) is a separate admin action. Narrow with the action switches (e.g. view only).
desc.partners: Partners: partner master (code, tax number, invoicing company, contact, visit window), contracts (min portions, prices, cycle, auto billing), quote requests, map.
desc.machines: Machines: asset register (barcode, type, counters, norms), deployment to partners, QR and Godex labels, machine history (tickets, worksheets, installed parts, warranty).
desc.products: Products: coffee and supplies master (price per portion, unit, VAT, consignment flag), price validity.
desc.settlements: Settlement: consignment settlements at partners (stock count, counters, payment method, debt), signature, receipt, replenishing partner stock, GLS shipping, own warehouse (site/van) and stocktake, parcels. The core field permission; also grants the parts warehouse (inherited).
desc.invoicing: Invoicing: issue and resend invoices via the invoicing provider, handover with invoice, coffee payment and vending telemetry pages, promotions. Sensitive: creates financial documents in the partner's name.
desc.agent_report: Sales rep report and statistics: revenue and commission per rep, map, trends, monthly closing, work-time summary (manager). Sees other employees' data.
desc.service: Service: open/manage tickets, maintenance cycles, edit a machine's service history. Automatically grants Intake and Knowledge base too (they used to be one permission).
desc.intake: Intake: bringing in a customer's machine with a receipt (AT number), photos, loaner, printing, then the mandatory worksheet form. Can be granted alone to external technicians.
desc.knowledge: Knowledge base: machine-type faults and proven fixes, reading/adding; the AI assistant uses it. The system manual (/kezikonyv) is available to everyone regardless.
desc.import_export: Import / Export: bulk import/export of partners, machines, products, full backup. Can change data in bulk — trusted roles only.
desc.payroll: Payroll export: payroll CSV (with social security number), work-time and leave exports. Personal data — grant narrowly.
desc.my_schedule: My schedule (self-service): own shifts, clock in/out, leave requests.
desc.my_tasks: My tasks / worksheet (self-service): assigned tasks, filling the worksheet (timer, works, materials, parts from own van, photo), work-time correction requests. No access to others' tasks.
desc.delete: Delete functions: permanent deletions anywhere (partner, machine, worksheet, warehouse, settlement…). Admin only by default. Action switches do not apply here: this is the “delete” capability itself.
desc.parts: Parts warehouse management (storekeeper): items, receipts, moves, location codes, labels, per-van min/max, issuing requests, procurement, stocktake, reports. Technicians only need “My tasks” for their van stock; this is the central storekeeper right.
